title: Foreman-A Worker Pool
description: Foreman-A coordinates workers 001-020 as one aggregated pool. The room shows pool summaries plus only important worker exceptions.

messages.text: Workers 001-020 are split into four lanes. Worker Pool reports lane totals, and only blocked lanes speak individually.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.open: Foreman-A assigns Packet A to workers 001-020.

messages.text: Pool A update: 20/20 workers are active, 740 blocks are placed, the shared seam is still locked, and no placements have failed.
Gate A is green. I am releasing the next dependency and keeping approved diffs immutable.
Pool A pulls Place from the Shared Skill Library. Workers 001-020 reuse the Foreman-E learned SKILL for the remaining straight rim rows, with air_check before each placement.
Pool A pulls Remove from the Shared Skill Library to clear temporary lane markers by tmp/* tag without learning a local cleanup routine.
Pool A complete. Final lane summaries and diff shards are flushed; no worker-level chat is needed beyond the aggregate report.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.close: Pool A completes Packet A and submits its diff shard.
